about.en: TQQQ xStock (TQQQx) is a tokenized tracker certificate on ProShares UltraPro QQQ, the 3x daily leveraged Nasdaq-100 ETF, issued by Backed under the xStocks brand. Each token is backed 1:1 by TQQQ shares held with qualified custodians and tracks the ETF price on-chain on Solana (XsjQP3iMAaQ3kQScQKthQpx9ALRbjKAjQtHg6TFomoc), Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum and other networks. xStocks are offered to non-US investors.
